en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a grand historic street in Cluj, showing a long neoclassical building with ornate façades, arched windows and Corinthian columns. To the left stands a church tower with a baroque onion dome and clock. Trees line the sidewalk and early‑ to mid‑20th‑century cars are visible on the road. The caption "CLUJ — Vedere" appears in the upper left corner.
